rows.sourceEnglish: The route must not erode the slope or send damaging water to a neighbour. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Ndlela ya kona a yi fanelanga ku kukula misava ya ndhawu yo rhelela kumbe ku rhumela mati lama onhaka eka muakelani. Xisele kumbe damu leri nga ehansi swi fanele ku kota ku ma amukela hi vuhlayiseki.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Ndlela ya kona a yi fanelanga ku kukula misava ya ndhawu yo rhelela kumbe ku rhumela mati lama onhaka eka muakelani. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Ndlela ya kona a yi fanelanga ku kukula misava ya ndhawu yo rhelela kumbe ku rhumela mati lama onhaka eka muakelani. Xisele (swale) kumbe damu leswi nga downstream swi fanele ku kota ku ma amukela hi ndlela leyi hlayisekeke.

rows.sourceEnglish: Keep good ground cover. Get a local assessment before digging on steep, wet or unstable land. Grass barriers and terraces also need a design suited to the site.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Hlayisa misava yi funengetekile kahle. Kuma nkambelo wa laha kaya u nga si cela eka steep, wet kumbe unstable land. Mindzilakano ya byanyi (grass barriers) na titerasi (terraces) na swona swi lava dizayini leyi faneleke ndhawu.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Hlayisa misava yi funengetekile kahle. Kuma nkambelo wa laha kaya u nga si cela eka steep, wet kumbe unstable land. Mindzilakano ya byanyi (grass barriers) na titerasi (terraces) na swona swi lava dizayini leyi faneleke ndhawu.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Hlayisa misava yi funengetekile kahle. Kuma nkambelo wa laha kaya u nga si cela eka ndhawu leyi rhelelaka ngopfu, leyi nga tsakama kumbe leyi nga tiyangiki. Mindzilakano ya byanyi (grass barriers) na titerasi (terraces) na swona swi lava dizayini leyi faneleke ndhawu.

rows.sourceEnglish: Rainfall seasons differ across South Africa. Use local records and plan for dry periods; a full dam is not guaranteed.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Tinguva ta mpfula ti hambana eAfrika Dzonga hinkwayo. Tirhisa tirhekhodo ta le kusuhi naswona plan for dry periods; damu leri teleke a ri tiyisiwangi.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Tinguva ta mpfula ti hambana eAfrika Dzonga hinkwaro. Tirhisa tirhekhodo ta le kusuhi naswona plan for dry periods; damu leri teleke a ri tiyisisiwi.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Tinguva ta mpfula ti hambana eAfrika Dzonga hinkwaro. Tirhisa tirhekhodo ta le kusuhi naswona u kunguhatela minkarhi yo oma; damu leri teleke a ri tiyisisiwi.

rows.sourceEnglish: Before changing a watercourse or building storage works, check the required authorisation with the water authority.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Loko u nga si cinca watercourse kumbe ku aka storage works, kamba authorisation leyi lavekaka eka water authority.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: U nga si cinca watercourse kumbe ku aka storage works, kambela authorisation leyi lavekaka eka water authority.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: U nga si cinca watercourse kumbe ku aka storage works, kambela authorisation leyi lavekaka eka water authority.

rows.sourceEnglish: A dam needs a site investigation and a design by a suitably qualified person. Catchment runoff, soil, foundations, downstream risk and a safe spillway all matter.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Damu ri lava site investigation na design hi munhu loyi a nga na suitable qualifications. Catchment runoff, soil, foundations, downstream risk na safe spillway, hinkwato i swa nkoka.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Damu ri lava site investigation na design hi munhu loyi a nga na suitable qualifications. Catchment runoff, soil, foundations, downstream risk na safe spillway, hinkwato i swa nkoka.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Damu ri lava site investigation na design hi munhu loyi a nga na qualifications leti faneleke. Catchment runoff, misava, foundations, downstream risk ni spillway leyi hlayisekeke, hinkwato i swa nkoka.

rows.sourceEnglish: An uncontrolled overflow can erode and breach the wall. Plan a safe route for excess water before construction.
rows.currentDeckTarget: An uncontrolled overflow can erode and breach the wall. Kunguhatela ndlela leyi hlayisekeke ya mati lama taleke ngopfu u nga si sungula ku aka.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: An uncontrolled overflow can erode and breach the wall. Kunguhatela ndlela leyi hlayisekeke ya mati lama taleke u nga si sungula ku aka.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Overflow leyi nga lawuriwiki yi nga erode and breach khumbi. Kunguhatela ndlela leyi hlayisekeke ya mati lama taleke u nga si sungula ku aka.

rows.sourceEnglish: Water can be lost through evaporation and seepage. Check the water level and look for leaks or erosion.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Mati ma nga lahleka hi evaporation and seepage. Kamba xiyimo xa mati naswona u lavisisa ku lutla kumbe ku gogodeka ka misava.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Mati ma nga lahleka hi evaporation na seepage. Kamba mpimo wa mati naswona lavisisa ku huma ka mati kumbe ku kukuleka ka misava.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Mati ma nga lahleka hi evaporation na seepage. Kamba mpimo wa mati naswona lavisisa ku huma ka mati kumbe ku kukuleka ka misava.

rows.sourceEnglish: Animals can damage banks and add manure to the water. Their presence does not make the water clean or safe.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Animals can damage banks and add manure to the water. Ku va kona ka swona a swi endli mati ma basa kumbe ku hlayiseka.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Swiharhi swi nga onha tibangi ta damu na ku engetela vulongo ematini. Ku va kona ka swona a swi endli mati ma basa kumbe ma hlayiseka.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Swiharhi swi nga onha banks na ku engetela vulongo ematini. Ku va kona ka swona a swi endli mati ma basa kumbe ma hlayiseka.

rows.sourceEnglish: Use the roof area seen from above and local rainfall records. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Tirhisa vukulu bya lwangu loko ri langutiwa hi le henhla na tirhekhodo ta mpfula ya le kusuhi. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Tirhisa vukulu bya lwangu loko ri langutiwa hi le henhla na tirhekhodo ta mpfula ya le kusuhi. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Tirhisa vukulu bya lwangu loko ri langutiwa hi le henhla na tirhekhodo ta mpfula ya le kusuhi. Kutani u tlhela u hlayela mati lama nga fikiki eka gutter, lama hambukisiwaka kumbe lama khulukaka ma huma eka thanki leyi teleke.

rows.sourceEnglish: An annual total does not tell you how much water will be available during a dry spell. Compare supply with the uses you plan.
rows.currentDeckTarget: An annual total does not tell you how much water will be available during a dry spell. Pimanisa supply na ku tirhisiwa ka mati loku u ku pulaneke.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Ntsengo wa lembe hinkwaro a wu ku byeli leswaku ku ta kumeka mati yo tala ku fikela kwihi hi nkarhi wa dry spell. Pimanisa supply na ku tirhisiwa ka mati loku u ku pulaneke.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Ntsengo wa lembe hinkwaro a wu ku byeli leswaku ku ta kumeka mati yo tala ku fikela kwihi hi nkarhi wo oma. Pimanisa mati lama kumekaka na ku tirhisiwa ka mati loku u ku pulaneke.

rows.sourceEnglish: Roof runoff can carry dust, droppings and other contamination. A first-flush diverter keeps some of the first runoff out of the tank.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Roof runoff yi nga rhwala ntshuri, droppings na other contamination. First-flush diverter yi hambukisa mati man’wana ya runoff yo sungula leswaku ma nga ngheni etankini.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Roof runoff yi nga rhwala ntshuri, droppings na other contamination. First-flush diverter yi hambukisa mati man’wana ya runoff yo sungula leswaku ma nga ngheni etankini.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Runoff ya lwangu yi nga rhwala ntshuri, droppings na contamination yin’wana. First-flush diverter yi hambukisa mati man’wana ya runoff yo sungula leswaku ma nga ngheni etankini.

rows.sourceEnglish: The required diversion depends on the roof and system. Use the supplier's sizing and maintenance instructions; there is no single volume for every roof.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Mati lama faneleke ku hambukisiwa ya titshege hi roof na system. Tirhisa the supplier's sizing and maintenance instructions; there is no single volume for every roof.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Mati lama faneleke ku hambukisiwa ya titshege hi roof na system. Tirhisa milawu ya supplier ya sizing na maintenance; a ku na volume yin’we ya roof yin’wana na yin’wana.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Mati lama faneleke ku hambukisiwa ya titshege hi lwangu na system. Tirhisa swiletelo swa muphakeri swa sizing na maintenance; a ku na volume yin’we ya lwangu rin’wana na rin’wana.

rows.sourceEnglish: Tank size depends on water demand, rain, roof area and the length of dry periods.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Sayizi ya thanki yi titshege hi xilaveko xa mati, mpfula, vukulu bya lwangu na vulehi bya dry periods.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Sayizi ya thanki yi titshege hi xilaveko xa mati, mpfula, vukulu bya lwangu na vulehi bya dry periods.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Sayizi ya thanki yi titshege hi xilaveko xa mati, mpfula, vukulu bya lwangu na vulehi bya minkarhi yo oma.

rows.sourceEnglish: List the intended uses and estimate their demand from your own records. Compare that with supply through the seasons.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Tsala intended uses kutani u anganyela demand ya wona hi ku tirhisa tirhekhodo ta wena. Pimanisa demand ya wona na supply hi tinguva.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Tsala intended uses kutani u anganyela demand ya wona hi ku tirhisa tirhekhodo ta wena. Pimanisa demand ya wona na supply hi tinguva.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Tsala ku tirhisiwa ka mati loku kunguhatiweke kutani u anganyela ntsengo wa mati lama lavekaka eka ku tirhisiwa koloko hi ku tirhisa tirhekhodo ta wena. Pimanisa ntsengo wolowo na mati lama kumekaka hi tinguva.

rows.sourceEnglish: Plan what you will do when stored water runs low. A province name alone cannot tell you the tank size you need.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Kunguhatela leswi u nga ta swi endla loko mati lama hlayisiweke ma sungula ku va matsongo. Vito ra province ntsena a ri ku byeli tank size leyi u yi lavaka.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Kunguhatela leswi u nga ta swi endla loko mati lama hlayisiweke ma sungula ku va matsongo. Vito ra province ntsena a ri ku byeli tank size leyi u yi lavaka.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Kunguhatela leswi u nga ta swi endla loko mati lama hlayisiweke ma sungula ku va matsongo. Vito ra xifundzankulu ntsena a ri ku byeli vukulu bya thanki leyi u yi lavaka.

rows.sourceEnglish: Keep the tank covered, screen openings against insects, and maintain the roof, gutters and diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Hlayisa thanki yi funengetiwile. Screen openings against insects, naswona hlayisa roof, gutters na diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Hlayisa thanki yi funengetiwile. Screen openings against insects, naswona hlayisa roof, gutters na diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Hlayisa thanki yi funengetiwile. Funengeta timbobo hi screen leswaku switsotswana swi nga ngheni, naswona hlayisa lwangu, gutters na diverter. Hlayisa mati ya mpfula ma hambanile ni tiphayiphi ta mati yo nwa.

rows.sourceEnglish: Water that looks clear may still contain germs or chemicals. Ask the local health authority about testing and treatment suited to the intended use.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Mati lama vonakaka ma basile ma nga ha va na germs kumbe chemicals. Vutisa local health authority hi testing na treatment leswi fambisanaka na intended use.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Mati lama vonakaka ma basile ma nga ha va na germs kumbe chemicals. Vutisa local health authority hi testing na treatment leswi fambisanaka na intended use.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Mati lama vonakaka ma basile ma nga ha va na germs kumbe chemicals. Vutisa health authority ya laha kaya hi testing na treatment leswi fambisanaka ni ku tirhisiwa ka mati loku kunguhatiweke.

rows.sourceEnglish: A basic filter alone is not a drinking-water guarantee. Water used on food crops also needs a safety assessment.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Basic filter ntsena a yi tiyisisi leswaku mati ma hlayisekile ku nwa. Mati lawa ya tirhisiwaka eka food crops na wona ya lava safety assessment.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Basic filter ntsena a yi tiyisisi leswaku mati ma hlayisekile ku nwa. Mati lawa ya tirhisiwaka eka food crops na wona ya lava safety assessment.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Basic filter ntsena a yi tiyisisi leswaku mati ma hlayisekile ku nwa. Mati lawa ya tirhisiwaka eka swirimiwa swa swakudya na wona ya lava nkambelo wa vuhlayiseki.

rows.sourceEnglish: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, stop using it and seek qualified local advice.
rows.currentDeckTarget: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, tshika ku ma tirhisa kutani u lava ndzayo ya qualified local adviser.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Loko reuse system yi ri karhi yi tirha naswona mati ma nunha, ma yima kumbe ma onha swimilana, tshika ku ma tirhisa kutani u lava ndzayo ya qualified local adviser.
rows.decision: Root approved exact-source complete learner paragraph reuse; independently checked, unreviewed.
rows.proposedTarget: Loko system yo tirhisa mati nakambe yi se ri karhi yi tirha naswona mati ma nunha, ma pool kumbe ma onha swimilana, tshika ku ma tirhisa kutani u lava ndzayo ya mutsundzuxi wa laha kaya loyi a nga qualified.
